claim.quote: A comprehensive analysis of PICO gamma calibration data demonstrates for the first time that electron recoils in C$_3$F$_8$ scale in accordance with a new nucleation mechanism, rather than one driven by a hot-spike as previously supposed.

name: Data-Driven Modeling of Electron Recoil Nucleation in PICO C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chambers

summary.plain: PICO's gamma calibration data show how the rare bubbles from electron recoils form in C3F8, which lets the team lower the energy threshold of PICO-40L while still ignoring gamma-ray backgrounds.
summary.technical: Semi-empirical electron-recoil nucleation model fit to all PICO C3F8 gamma-calibration datasets (including PICO-2L and PICO-60 runs and test chambers); projects thermodynamic thresholds as low as 2.8 keV for PICO-40L (Phys. Rev. D 100, 082006). The PICO-40L reach quoted in the abstract is a projection.

title: Data-Driven Modeling of Electron Recoil Nucleation in PICO C$_3$F$_8$ Bubble Chambers
why_it_matters: The abstract says the model lets thresholds be tuned to lower-energy nuclear recoils while keeping excellent electron-recoil rejection.
